name: Lahai Roi
overview: Lahai Roi, also known as Beer-Lahai Roi, is the place where Hagar fled after leaving Sarai, as described in Genesis 16. There, the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain in the wilderness and assured her of God's care, promising to multiply her descendants and revealing that her son Ishmael would be born because God had heard her affliction. This location marks a significant moment of divine intervention and mercy in the lives of Hagar and her son, who would dwell among his brethren. Later, Isaac also dwelt in this area, linking Lahai Roi to the ongoing narrative of God's covenant people.
